name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.NativeHop.nand_reach_saturate
title: NAND local propagation saturates: every wire of a NAND circuit can take both values in any propagation-closed value system
statement: For a NAND circuit with n inputs and g gates (gate j is wire n+j, with inputs a j, b j < n+j), any family of value sets R closed under gate propagation and equal to {0,1} on the inputs is {0,1} on every wire.
